finding.title: Make SacredWindowDao's cache replace atomic — clearAll()+insertAll() must be one transaction, not the caller's fire-and-forget chain
finding.why: The DAO's own doc comment says '[clearAll] + [insertAll] are called together... Expects the caller to have called [clearAll] first so the table stays coherent' — but the DAO exposes no atomic way to do that, and the only caller (SacredWindowRepository._persistToDb) chains them with `.then(...).ignore()`: unawaited, no transaction, errors silently discarded. If the process dies (routine on mobile backgrounding) between clearAll() completing and insertAll() completing, sacred_window_entries is left empty. That table is the documented source of truth for 'background notification-fire-time checks... without the Flutter engine' (DNI-367) — an empty table means Sacred Time notification suppression silently fails open on next cold-start check, with no error anywhere (`.ignore()` explicitly suppresses it). invalidate() → _persistToDb runs on every location/timezone change and app resume, so the window isn't rare.
finding.recommendation: Add a single `SacredWindowDao.replaceAll(List<SacredWindowEntriesCompanion> entries)` that wraps clearAll+insertAll in one `db.transaction()`, and have sacred_window_repository.dart call that instead of the `.then().ignore()` chain. If fire-and-forget is intentional, at minimum log the failure via AppLogger instead of `.ignore()`.
acceptance_criteria: SacredWindowDao exposes an atomic replaceAll(); sacred_window_repository.dart no longer calls clearAll()/insertAll() separately.
A test makes insertAll throw mid-write inside replaceAll and asserts the table still holds the PREVIOUS rows (no empty-table window), not a partially-cleared state.
